meta: Find video ideas from comments with AI: your audience's real questions are the best source of ideas, so you're never stuck.

muc.title: Ideas live in the comments
muc.text: The best video ideas usually aren't in your head; they're in your audience's comments.

muc.title: Copy the comments
muc.text: Mark học AI copies the questions from comments, removes the names, then pastes them into a chatbot, an AI chat assistant.

muc.title: Biggest groups first
muc.text: Ask AI to group similar questions, count how many people asked, and start with the biggest group.

muc.title: One idea per video
muc.text: Then ask AI to turn each group into one video idea, each with just one thing viewers can do right away.

muc.title: Five ideas for next week
muc.text: Paste your twenty latest comments into a chatbot and ask it to group them into five video ideas for next week.

thu: Paste your 20 latest comments (names removed) into a chatbot and ask it to group them into 5 video ideas for next week.
